jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
HBX Group  is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team  HBX Group , are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.  
  JOB DESCRIPTION: 
  We are looking for a  Cloud Platform Engineer  to design, scale, and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will champion infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, streamline developer velocity through robust CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability, security, and cost efficiency.   We actively embrace  AI-assisted engineering . We expect you to leverage modern generative AI tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLMs, automated agents) to accelerate code generation, generate test suites, optimize documentation, and augment incident troubleshooting and platform support.   Key Responsibilities    Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure as Code  
 Design, provision, and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient multi-account AWS architectures. 
 Define and enforce modular, reusable  Terraform  configurations with strict state management and automated testing. 
 Manage containerized workloads using  Amazon ECS / EKS or Rancher  and serverless services ( AWS Lambda, API Gateway ). 
   AI-Augmented Engineering & Operations  
 Integrate AI tools into your daily workflow to generate and review IaC, automate repetitive tasks, and draft infrastructure test cases. 
 Experiment with and implement AI-driven tooling for log analysis, root cause investigation, automated triage, and internal developer support runbooks. 
 Guide and mentor fellow engineers on safe, pragmatic uses of AI coding assistants to increase team throughput without compromising security. 
   CI/CD & Developer Enablement  
 Build and optimize deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD) with built-in security scans (SAST, Trivy, tfsec/trivy-iac) and automated testing. 
 Collaborate closely with product engineering teams to eliminate deployment friction and improve internal platform self-service. 
   Observability, Reliability & Security  
 Establish comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing across all services using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent tooling. 
 Implement cloud security best practices: least-privilege IAM policies, KMS encryption, secret management, VPC design, and automated vulnerability management. 
 Participate in a lightweight, blameless on-call rotation and lead post-incident reviews to continuously improve system reliability. 
 Monitor cloud spend, identify waste, and drive cost-optimization (FinOps) initiatives. 
    Required Qualifications   
 
 5+ years  of professional experience managing cloud platforms in production environments, with a primary focus on  AWS . 
 
 Deep Terraform expertise : Demonstrable experience building reusable modules, managing remote state, handling drift, and implementing policy-as-code (e.g., OPA, Sentinel, or Checkov). 
 
 AI-First Mindset : Active experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/ChatGPT, Amazon Q Developer) to boost coding velocity, debug configuration errors, and draft documentation. 
 Strong networking fun
